body:
Implements the rename list of ADR-004 (docs/wiki/decisions/adr-004-roles-and-adoption.md) — docs/strings only, no behavior change:

1. Exit-code lists: add 4 (= the dispatcher gave itself up; a supervisor — cron, systemd, Actions — or you starts a fresh one) to skills/kanban/references/protocol.md (~230) and the cli.js global help line (currently stops at 3 = LOCK_LOST).
2. --reviewer <profile> -> --reviewer <github-user> in skills/kanban/SKILL.md:63 and cli.js:161 (docs match lifecycle.js:226-237; code unchanged).
3. "fake-gh harness" -> "fake-gh test double" at 4 sites: cli.js:429, model.js:434 (worker-facing deny message), SKILL.md:66, CLAUDE.md:26.
4. context.js:10 "a comment a human meant for" -> "a comment the operator meant for" (kills the contradiction with context.js:107).
5. SKILL.md:12 subtitle "the worker protocol" -> "the board protocol".
6. README.md:229 "a runner" -> "an Actions runner"; qualify track runner vs Actions runner everywhere.
7. protocol.md: add a short glossary (seat vs reviewer = per-card gate, always a GitHub user; profile = harness adapter; host = machine identity; track runner = worker mode) and document the reserved synthetic profile values dispatcher/reviewer/human in the attempts schema (human reads as: the operator by hand).

Deliberately unchanged (do NOT rename): dispatcher, worker, kb:needs-human, kb:agent:* namespace, attempt-history values, README "Humans get" line, doctor.js operator sites.
title: Seats vocabulary sync: one docs/strings PR from ADR-004
